title: Spell formula version 4
description: SpellFormula::RandomizeForName (0x5BE120) knows versions 1 to 3 and leaves the stored taper ids (63, Red Taper) for any other version, so ClientMagicSystem::CastSpell refuses the cast ("You do not have all of this spell's components") for a player who owns the per-account tapers but no Red Taper, and the spell examine panel shows the wrong tapers. Version 4 takes the scarab from comps[0], the herb from comps[3], the powder from comps[4] and the talisman from comps[6], and fills the taper slots comps[1], comps[2] and comps[5] per account (seeds hash % 0x13D573, 0x4AEFD and 0x96A7F; result % 12 + 63), like the server's RandomizeVersion4. A version 5 would be one more compare in the cave plus another body. Needs the code-space entry.

items.change: Spell formula version 4: taper slots per account

edits.note: SpellFormula::RandomizeForName: the unknown-version exit (xor eax,eax; retn 8) jumps to the cave
cave (formula_v4.asm): tests for version 4 (eax = version - 3) and otherwise returns 0 as before; for version 4 builds the components as described above
